cases.name: Over 3 segments
cases.text: Acme: 8 days to Acme Summit 2026! Here is everything you need before you arrive. The agenda is live at go.acme.io/k3P9xq with all 24 talks, the workshop schedule and the speaker list. Doors open at 8:30 at Lakeside Hall, 1800 S Lake Shore Dr, Chicago. Bring the QR code from your confirmation email; badges are printed at the north entrance. Parking is in the Lakeside garage, $18 for the day. Can't make it in person? Join online: the livestream starts at 09:00 Central. Reply STOP to opt out
